doc: The Limen browser/engine wire contract. Plain JSON-serializable data only. This file is the single source of truth: every language binding is generated from it by tools/contract-gen and must never be edited by hand.

constants.name: PROTOCOL_VERSION
constants.doc: The wire envelope major version. Revision 1.1 added the handshake and the generic capability envelope, both additive.

constants.name: PROTOCOL_MINOR
constants.doc: Additive revision within PROTOCOL_VERSION. An engine that understands only 1.0 ignores the handshake and is treated as a legacy engine.

types.name: CorrelationId
types.doc: Identifies one requested effect so its result can be matched to the question it answers, and a stale answer rejected.

types.name: Capability
types.doc: What the kernel implements, announced once in Initialize. Not a statement about what this browser will permit at the moment an effect runs: permission and availability are reported per effect, in that effect's own outcome.

types.name: SemanticEvent
types.doc: `name` is a domain-chosen identifier (the value of a data-event attribute). The bridge does not know its meaning; only the engine interprets it.

types.name: BrowserLocation
types.doc: The browser's current URL, split mechanically by the kernel. Deciding what a path means is application meaning, so the kernel never parses further than this.

fields.name: origin
fields.doc: Scheme, host and port, no trailing slash.

types.name: EffectOutcome
types.doc: The outcome of an Http effect. OutcomeUnknown exists because a timed-out request may already have reached the server; it must never be collapsed into Failure.

fields.name: body
fields.doc: The decoded response body. The engine narrows it with its own typed decoder.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Present exactly when a response was received (invalid-response).

types.name: StorageOutcome
types.doc: A single localStorage call is atomic, so there is no dispatched-but-uncertain case. Success.value is null when a key was absent or the operation was set/remove.

types.name: ClipboardFailureReason
types.doc: denied is usually recoverable by another user gesture; unavailable never is in this browser.

types.name: NavigationOutcome
types.doc: Dispatched is not a weaker Success: back/forward only ask the browser to move, and the move arrives later as LocationChanged, or never.

types.name: CapabilityId
types.doc: The identity of an optional capability pack, e.g. limen.focus. Chosen by the pack's own contract unit; Core never interprets it beyond equality.

types.name: CapabilityOutcome
types.doc: How Core answers a capability effect. Completed carries the capability's own closed outcome, which is where its success, failure, cancellation and unknown variants live. Unsupported and Rejected are compatibility facts, never effect outcomes: they mean the request was not executed.

fields.name: result
fields.doc: Encoded by the capability's generated binding; decoded by the engine with the same.

types.name: ContractIdentity
types.doc: Identifies one generated contract unit. The fingerprint is SHA-256 over the unit's canonical JSON with documentation removed.

types.name: CapabilityOffer
types.doc: An optional capability the host implements. An offer is not permission.

types.name: HandshakeRejection
types.doc: Why an engine refused the host. Protocol incompatibility is a compatibility state, never an effect OutcomeUnknown.

fields.name: capabilities
fields.doc: The capabilities this engine will use. Every one must have been offered with the same version and fingerprint.

variants.name: Initialize
variants.doc: Delivered once at startup. handshake is absent only from kernels older than protocol 1.1.

variants.name: LocationChanged
variants.doc: The browser moved through history on its own. Adopt it; never answer it with another navigation.

variants.name: CapabilityFact
variants.doc: A browser-originated fact from a negotiated capability (a subscription update, a lifecycle change). Not correlated with a result.

fields.name: fact
fields.doc: Encoded by the capability's generated binding.

types.name: ViewState
types.doc: A projection, not the engine's internal state: named values a view binds to and named lists it repeats.

fields.name: headers
fields.doc: Never surfaced in diagnostics: headers commonly carry credentials.

fields.name: body
fields.doc: Pre-serialized by the engine; the kernel never interprets it.

types.name: ClipboardEffectRequest
types.doc: Write-only by design (LCP-019 intentional non-parity). text is never surfaced in diagnostics.

types.name: NavigationEffectRequest
types.doc: url is same-origin and root-relative; the kernel refuses anything else.

types.name: CapabilityEffectRequest
types.doc: A request to a negotiated optional capability. request is encoded by that capability's generated binding; Core routes it by capability and never interprets it.

fields.name: cancellations
fields.doc: Previously requested effects whose result is no longer wanted. Only the engine decides this.

fields.name: handshake
fields.doc: Only meaningful on the response to Initialize.
